name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
research: Seated body from the proven dumbbell_shoulder_press (bench 85, root (0,-0.035,0.494) rot -6). Block 0.26x0.14x0.08 m centred (0.12,-0.70): top z 0.08, spans y -0.77..-0.63. Left forefoot on it, ball of foot fixed at y_b = -0.66, z 0.08, heel off the back edge. Foot model: ankle sits 0.15 behind and 0.074 above the ball (rest foot; estimate). Foot rot X +a raises the heel. Start a = -15 (S1 range start): ankle = ball + (0.15 cos15 + 0.074 sin15, -0.15 sin15 + 0.074 cos15) = (-0.66+0.164, 0.08+0.033) = (y -0.496, z 0.113). End a = +30: (0.15 cos30 - 0.074 sin30, 0.15 sin30 + 0.074 cos30) = (0.093, 0.139) -> (y -0.567, z 0.219). Hip ~(0.11,-0.02,0.50): hip-ankle 0.62-0.64 m, knee ~90 deg; the thigh lifts ~7 cm at the end. Right foot flat (z 0.074). Dumbbell across the lower left thigh (handle ~ (0.12,-0.40,0.70) world, palm down, axis [-1,0,0]): shoulder (0.22,-0.06,0.97) -> hand vector (-0.10, 0.34 fwd, -0.27) = 0.44 m -> elbow ~93 deg with elev 30 / plane 30 folding forward-in; end the knee is ~7 cm higher -> elev 25 / plane 35 / elbow 100. Right hand (no prop) rests palm-down on the right thigh. S1 Kovacs 2024 (knee 90, -15..+30 deg ankle), S2 StrengthLog.
